digest.component_or_area: LLM model-class resolution for hand-built RunRequest sub-calls
propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sub-calls pass config=cfg with no declared model class, so they inherit cfg.model and bypass the model-class configuration, sending content to direct Anthropic instead of the configured provider.
overlap-judge made 18 of 23 LLM calls in a plan review, so a class-only Bedrock cutover leaves the majority of plan-review traffic on direct Anthropic.
ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain, so it leaks ticket content on ordinary rebar comment/create calls with no gate invocation to reveal it.
A regression test must pin the class-table-differs-from-cfg.model configuration, since a Bedrock-everything config passes even with the bug unfixed because bypassing calls inherit cfg.model.

The three genuine sub-calls should select from the class vocabulary (ticket-digest trivial, overlap-judge standard, code-novelty standard) while top-level single-call ops keep cfg.model as the operator knob.
A general AST provenance guard must fail if any hand-built sub-call inherits the raw config model, rather than enumerating today's sites by name.
